title: The card machine's down
setting: The end of a casual dinner. Their server, Matt, comes back looking apologetic. Slightly denser reductions; speed stays near the last scene.

lines.speaker: matt
lines.text: Hey, so, this is annoying, but our card machine's down. Do you guys have cash?
lines.spoken: Hey, so, this is annoying, but our card machine's down. D'you guys have cash?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh. Uh. I have like... six bucks.
lines.spoken: Oh. Uh. I have like... six bucks.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I only have a card. Of course.
lines.spoken: I only have a card. Of course.

lines.speaker: matt
lines.text: Yeah, it's been down all night. There's an ATM in the convenience store next door, if that helps.
lines.spoken: Yeah, it's been down all night. There's an ATM in the convenience store next door, if that helps.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I can run next door. That's fine.
lines.spoken: I can run next door. That's fine.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You sure? I can come with you.
lines.spoken: You sure? I can come with you.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Nah, I got it. I'll be like two minutes.
lines.spoken: Nah, I got it. I'll be like two minutes.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. I'll watch the table. You wanna just leave your jacket?
lines.spoken: Okay. I'll watch the table. You wanna just leave your jacket?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. Thanks. If they come back, just tell them I'm getting cash.
lines.spoken: Yeah. Thanks. If they come back, just tell 'em I'm getting cash.

lines.speaker: matt
lines.text: Appreciate you. Sorry again. This thing's been dying on us all week.
lines.spoken: Appreciate you. Sorry again. This thing's been dying on us all week.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Do you want me to throw in once he's back? I can give you the six, at least.
lines.spoken: D'you want me to throw in once he's back? I can give you the six, at least.

lines.speaker: matt
lines.text: Whatever you guys wanna do is fine. I'll come back in a minute.
lines.spoken: Whatever you guys wanna do is fine. I'll come back in a minute.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Don't lose your place in line. Those ATMs get weird at night.
lines.spoken: Don't lose your place in line. Those ATMs get weird at night.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I won't. Tell him I'll be two minutes. For real this time.
lines.spoken: I won't. Tell 'im I'll be two minutes. For real this time.

gist.askEn: How are they going to solve it?
accept: Chris will go to the ATM

chunks.meaningZh: 刷卡机坏了 / 不能刷卡。
chunks.sayAfter: The card machine's down. Do you guys have cash?
I only have a card. I can run next door.
I can run next door. I'll be like two minutes.

roleplay.setupZh: 吃完饭要结账，服务员说刷卡机坏了。你只带了卡，需要想办法：去隔壁取现，或者问问对方有没有现金。
roleplay.aiRole: Matt, a tired but decent server, plus Maya who only has about six dollars. Nobody is angry. Keep it practical and a little awkward in a normal way.
variants: The ATM next door is also down.
Maya finds enough cash after all.
They ask if they can send payment digitally; Matt has to check.
starters: You sure? I can come with you.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话讲：刷卡机怎么了，谁去取钱，Maya 要怎么跟服务员说。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell what happened with the card machine, who went for cash, and what Maya was supposed to tell the server. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
